project_context: Windows desktop application built with Angular (UI) and Electron (Container). It functions as a monthly finance tracker displaying entries (date, notes, amount, entrata/uscita) with sidebar aggregations.

response.entries: [{id, date, notes, amount, type, category, subType}]

tasks.title: Angular UI and Data Binding
tasks.description: Develop the main view with a left sidebar for balances and a main central area for the monthly list view. Implement month navigation arrows, entry formatting (entrata/uscita flags), and the '+' floating action button. Bind data to the IPC contract.

tasks.title: Electron Main Process and IPC
tasks.description: Initialize the Electron container configured for Windows. Set up local JSON or SQLite storage. Expose IPC handlers (get-entries, add-entry, get-balances) matching the shared_contract.

tasks.title: Author Test Suites
tasks.description: Write Playwright/Electron integration tests inside ./tests/ testing the IPC contract mock data, window rendering, and UI assertions.

tasks.title: Execute Integration Tests
tasks.description: Run the test suites authored in TASK-03 against the completed TASK-01 and TASK-02 builds. Issue structured rework reports if assertions fail.

tasks.title: Fisco and Ectoplasma UI Controls and Sub-balances
tasks.description: Add Fisco and Ectoplasma toggle buttons below Entrata/Uscita in modal. Enforce at least one selected for entrate. Add sub-balance displays under Totale, Annuale, Mensile in sidebar.

tasks.title: Fisco Isolation & Ectoplasma Calculations in Store
tasks.description: Isolate standard balances to Fisco entrate only; compute aggregate balances considering Ectoplasma in separate metrics.

tasks.title: Verify Fisco & Ectoplasma Conformance
tasks.description: Test contract conformance, UI rendering of Fisco/Ectoplasma elements, and strict balance separation in integration tests.
